description: This file defines an abstract base class 'tlTable' in PHP for rendering tables within the TestLink project. It includes properties for table configuration and data, and methods for creating table columns and rendering table components, with some methods requiring implementation by subclasses.

classes.name: tlTable
classes.description: An abstract class for rendering tables, providing properties and methods for managing table columns, data, and rendering logic, to be extended by concrete table implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing table columns and data, processing flexible input formats, and generating column identifiers.

methods.name: renderCommonGlobals
methods.description: Abstract method to output shared JavaScript or global code for all tables.

methods.name: renderHeadSection
methods.description: Abstract method to output the HTML <head> section for the table rendering.

methods.name: renderBodySection
methods.description: Abstract method to output the HTML <body> section for the table rendering.

methods.name: titleToColumnName
methods.description: Converts a column title into a safe JavaScript identifier, ensuring uniqueness within the table.
